cases.condition: Input is unsafe/invalid JSON, or a CIF manifest is blocked, schema-invalid, identity-inconsistent, previously transformed, partially occupied, or disordered.
cases.minimum_next_action: Provide one immutable valid source or resolve the upstream CIF manifest blocker without dropping identity, occupancy, disorder, or lineage evidence.

cases.condition: The requested output exists, aliases evidence, or the platform cannot perform no-replace atomic publication.
cases.minimum_next_action: Choose a new path in a trusted supported directory and preserve the original evidence.

cases.condition: A site has mixed species or total occupancy below one.
cases.minimum_next_action: Choose and document an ordered or statistical physical occupancy model.

cases.condition: Occupancy, charge, spin, symmetry, PBC, cell beyond tolerance, site identity, or a nonperiodic coordinate changes.
cases.minimum_next_action: Treat the child as lossy or independently derived and resolve every reported difference.

cases.condition: The requested repeat would produce more than 4096 sites.
cases.minimum_next_action: Reduce the repeat or move the reviewed operation to a separately bounded production backend.

cases.condition: A slab, interface, site edit, adsorbate, host-guest, strain, collision, or cell budget is invalid or unsupported.
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve the parents, revise one explicit construction parameter or use a separately validated backend route, and rerun without stability claims.

cases.condition: Symmetry evidence, molecular charge, or spin multiplicity is unresolved or only declared.
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve charge and spin explicitly and attach versioned symmetry evidence when symmetry is claimed.

cases.condition: Only site order or integer image shifts on axes periodic in both structures differ within tolerance.
cases.minimum_next_action: Retain the site-mapping hash and every periodic image shift for independent review.

cases.condition: A positive-determinant integer supercell matrix produces at most 4096 sites from a fully periodic parent.
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve one-to-many mapping and recompute symmetry before any downstream use.

cases.condition: A slab, coherent interface, explicit site edit, adsorbate, host-guest placement, or bounded strain passes deterministic lineage and geometry gates.
cases.minimum_next_action: Retain all parent identities and candidates; obtain independent symmetry, electronic-state, energy, force, and convergence evidence before selecting a stable structure.

cases.condition: A QE, VASP, CP2K, or SIESTA handoff is requested after local readiness gates.
cases.minimum_next_action: Pass the source and plan to the selected rigorous-calculation skill for code-specific choices.

cases.condition: Every identity domain, representation, site order, electronic state, symmetry field, and coordinate matches.
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve both source hashes and package the exact round-trip report for review.

cases.condition: Pinned pymatgen or RDKit distribution metadata is absent, matched, or version-mismatched.
cases.minimum_next_action: Use a separate version-pinned integration gate before any provider-backed operation.

cases.condition: No earlier case matches exactly or required evidence is incomplete, ambiguous, or internally inconsistent.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop without mutation or handoff and obtain the exact missing evidence for a declared earlier case.
